newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks weak at open, Alcatel rallies.
newsitem.headline: French stocks weak at open, Alcatel rallies.

text.p: French stocks easied slightly on Wednesday from the previous day's year high as investors waited for U.S. inflation data due at 1230 GMT and the opening of the U.S. markets.
Wall Street's bull run, pushing the Dow above 6,000 points, triggered a rally in European markets on Tuesday.
The bourse's blue chip CAC-40 index was down 0.2 percent at 2,163.97. The futures contract was down four points at 2,168.
The French government announced on Wednesday that it wanted to sell electronics group Thomson to missiles-to-magazines conglomerate Lagardere.
Trading in shares in Lagardere, Thomson and its subsidiary Thomson-CSF was delayed at the opening.
Shares in Alcatel Alsthom, which put in a rival bid for Thomson, rallied 3.4 percent to 460 francs in early trade.
